senses.gloss:
ऊर्मि ऊर्मि, probably क्वृ + मि, m. and f. A wave, Bhartṛ. 2, 4.
 --Comp.

ऊर्मिन् ऊर्मिन्, i. e. ऊर्मि + इन्, adj., f. णी, Wavy (ved.).
 --Comp.
ऊर्मिमन्त् ऊर्मि + मन्त्, adj., f. मती, adj. Surgy, Rām. 4, 9, 38.
ऊर्मि- + भुज ऊर्मि- + भुज, m. an arm-like wave, i. e. a wave instead of an arm, Śiś. 9, 38.

ऊर्मि- + मालिन् ऊर्मि- + मालिन्,
 I. adj. adorned with a chaplet of waves, Rām. 2, 113, 21.
 II. m. the sea, Ragh. 5, 61.

ऊर्मि- + षट्क ऊर्मि- + षट्क, n. the six waves (human infirmities), which obstruct the course of quiet life, viz. grief, ignorance, old age, death, hunger, and thirst, Lass. 58, 9 (where thus to be corrected).
